description: Return the catalog datasets, audited MCP servers and ingestion skills that AI agents use more than in the previous period, from Signal Lab's own usage counters (agent page visits and MCP calls that fetch one entry; search crawlers excluded). Window 24h, 7d or 30d, ending with the last full day (US Pacific). Each row: rank, type, slug, name, uses, prev (previous window), growth (smoothed), agents (distinct agent names) and url. An entry needs 5+ uses from 2+ agents.
name: get_trending
title: Get trending entries
